title: ImUi Image Item Proof v1
problem: Add the first response-bearing IMUI image item and image button proof in the policy layer: `fret-ui-kit::imui` should expose stable-ID image authoring over Fret's `ImageId` / `ImageProps` mechanism while keeping asset loading app-owned and `fret-imui` runtime policy-light.

repro.summary: Compile the public IMUI image item / image button authoring API and run the focused `fret-ui-kit` IMUI smoke tests.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_image_item_smoke --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui image_item --no-fail-fast

gates.name: image-item-public-smoke
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_image_item_smoke --no-fail-fast

gates.name: image-item-helper-tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui image_item --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This lane closed after landing the focused image item / image button proof. Any asset-loader tutorial, image atlas/runtime texture stack, background/tint parity, or broader image editing surface should start as a separate proof-led follow-on.
